sections.Profile:
"Serenade" is a two-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Williams Electronic Manufacturing Company in 1960. ​ Designed by Harry Mabs, with artwork by George Molentin, the game features a musical pirate theme, capturing the lively spirit of a pirate serenade. The playfield includes two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, three standup targets, two gobble holes, and a kick-out hole.
